en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ali Bin Hadeed, from Jameel Bin Darraj, and others, 
(It has been narrated) from one of the two (5<sup>th</sup> or 6<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>)
regarding a man who retracted from Al-Islam. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘He would be told to repent, so if he does repent (fine), or else killed’.
